# Captured RF codes — Crompton fan remote (433.92 MHz, ASK/OOK)

Captured via ESPHome CC1101 (ESP32-C3) on 2026-11-20. All codes are FIXED (non-rolling):
each button sends the same frame repeatedly (~5-7 bursts per press, ~60 ms apart).

None decode as standard RCSwitch; the CanalSatLD decoder partially matches (device=0x19,
address=0x36) but with unreliable command decoding, so raw pulse lists are used for TX.
